title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Soil
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Soil. Upper layer of the earth in which plants grow. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here); the ontology declares no further own owl:Restriction for Soil beyond this subclassing. Soil-related measurements (e.g. soil moisture, soil temperature, captured by SoilTensiometer/Thermometer observations) are produced against this entity as their saref:FeatureOfInterest, not stored directly on the Soil entity itself. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriSoil' entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Soil'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. A human-readable name for this soil feature of interest.

isLocatedIn.description: Relationship. s4agri:isLocatedIn some geo:Feature. The s4agri:isLocatedIn property definition ('the physical location of a saref4agri entity, e.g. an animal') is generic and reused here to relate a Soil feature of interest to the Parcel/Farm it is physically part of; not formally restricted to Soil in the published v2.1.1 ttl.
